title: Add new well-known Endpoint and MessageAction types for calendar, task, filenode
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Endpoint and MessageAction type tables, add the following new well-known type URIs: urn:jmap:chat:cap:calendar-event (links to a CalendarEvent; uri is a calendar event URL or JMAP CalendarEvent ID); urn:jmap:chat:cap:availability (invitation to Principal/getAvailability free/busy lookup); urn:jmap:chat:cap:task (links to a Task; uri is a JMAP Task ID or task tracking URL); urn:jmap:chat:cap:filenode (links to a FileNode; uri is a FileNode URL). All follow the existing extensible URI namespace pattern.
